post_title: Airbnb or a long-term lease? The biggest number isn't always allowed.
caption:
Same house. Airbnb or a long-term lease? 🏡

Short-term rentals can win big on paper. Then the city weighs in. Head to head:

• Revenue: ~$4,834 vs $2,200 a month. Airbnb wins.
• Costs: $4,311 vs $2,157 a month. Long-term wins.
• Cash flow: +$523 vs +$43 a month. Airbnb wins.
• Rules risk: many cities cap, permit or ban STRs. Long-term wins.

Two all. The best number means nothing if it's not allowed. Check the local rules before you buy.

Example numbers: $260K house, 25% down, 7% 30-year; Airbnb at 60% occupancy and $265/night with 35% for cleaning, platform fees and management plus $400 utilities.
